answer: The design leans on unique-model fingerprint attestation, voided if the audit panel is not diverse, idle agents bleed standing. Work waits on the ripple until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the sonnet of the next round. Written in a short declarative sentences register, it stays short. The gale of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce.
